info.title: Slack Web API (scoped)
info.description: Scoped OpenAPI 3.0 specification for the Slack Web API, generated from Slack's current documentation at https://docs.slack.dev/reference/methods (retrieved 2026-07-09). Covers the chat, conversations, auth, users, canvases, and bookmarks method families. This is a generated spec (Slack no longer publishes an official OpenAPI document); the last official Slack OpenAPI was v1.7.0, frozen in 2020.
